== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Bloody Thorn is a celebrated combatant and returning champion who performs in front of large, enthusiastic crowds. During her matches, she utilizes a fighting style centered around [[needles]], which she can manipulate to float in the air or rise from the ground to surround her opponents. She is capable of switching between different cores during combat, a tactic used to manage illusions or change her fighting state. Despite her prowess and the protection provided by her thick [[Enforced]] robes, she is capable of being wounded or caught off guard, as seen when she was eventually forced to kneel with a weapon at her throat following a chaotic engagement.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Known as the [[Daughter of Dread]], Bloody Thorn is an experienced arena fighter and a returning champion of [[Truegold]] rank. Having trained in the [[Path of Twin Stars]], she possesses the ability to switch cores to utilize different types of [[madra]]. During combat, she employs an earth core to wield yellow [[earth madra]] alongside [[pure madra]]. Her martial repertoire includes the [[Empty Palm]] [[technique]] and a specialized [[Ruler technique]] involving her signature [[needle]] weapons.}}
